section_intro: The geometry layer is the URM's account of what a record surface produces on its own when asked how far apart two records are, how much of a region reaches its outside, and what a coupling priced by that structure can carry. The first eight blocks enter through ProjectModel methods delegating to model/geometry.py, with exact F2 arithmetic on the gated measurement path. `python3 model/validate_geometry.py --no-chain` now runs 33 checks with 0 fail: 25 geometry gates on those eight blocks and eight hardened C-71/C-72 formation gates narrated in §3. Those eight blocks also quote sealed sweeps, controls and tables outside the URM, and each scope cell identifies that boundary. T-54 now homes the next three blocks as well: P-GEO-9 through ProjectModel.reachable_class and checks_classes.py, P-GEO-10 through ProjectModel.critical_kernel and checks_classes.py, and P-GEO-11 through ProjectModel.writing_kernel_verdict and checks_writing.py. Only P-GEO-11a remains permanent narration over its sealed composition lane with no model function or validator gate. Every block prints its rows with live ledger status and carrier marks. C-79, which carries the boundary law in both tiers and the CERT = IR2 identity, remains CANDIDATE wherever cited. The results are mathematics about DEF-A stabiliser carriers, two modelled world venues built from published constants, and a census-shaped access model; by H-3 they say nothing about the world by themselves. On stabiliser venues every Pauli expectation is -1, 0 or +1, so a continuously decaying pure-Γ profile cannot appear there; every corner-tier null remains scoped to that tier. The verdict these results feed is §6's single block, made once after the classes were computed.

claims.headline: distance is earned on the record surface as boundary-crossing cost
claims.prose: The record level yields one notion of separation on its own: d_W(s,s'), the minimum weight of an admissible operation carrying configuration s to configuration s'. The model searches the full affine space of admissible writers per configuration pair against the computed conjugate logical pairs — never nominated ones — and takes the minimum by exact popcount over the whole coset; the class minima are {L, L, 2L} and the computed code distance is L at L = 2, 3, 4. The validator gates two routes into that structure separately, six gates in all: the class minima at each L, and the full 4 x 4 d_W matrix at each L entry by entry through ProjectModel.distance. The URM's route is the toric one and stops there — everything that follows in this block is the sealed lane's, run once and reproduced by no gate. That lane closed 2^24 = 16777216 writers per pair at L = 5, 268435456 in total, and found d_W satisfying all four metric axioms over all pairs and all triples on eight configuration venues — toric L = 2, 3, 4, 5, the [[4,2,2]], [[6,4,2]] and [[8,6,2]] codes, and D(Z2xZ2) — and on two WORLD record venues: the census barrier-work distance on a weighted hypercube Q_6 whose six weights are published activation energies, where additivity over the flip set is earned by Dijkstra over all conversion paths rather than assumed; and, on a hidden NAND-like interaction grid seen only through its 64 x 64 coupling matrix, a monotone map of that matrix which earns the axioms at exactly one exponent, delta = U^(-1/3), pinned from both sides by triangle failure above it and dimension inflation below. Neither world venue is an instrument reading: both are built from published constants and a declared generator, and the grid's triangle scan is float64 at a stated 1e-9 relative tolerance rather than exact. Failing controls sit on the same instruments in different configurations — the imported product form d1+d2 breaks on D(Z2xZ2) at the printed witness; squared barrier work breaks the triangle inequality on Q_6 with 72832 violations; a direction-dependent work breaks symmetry there; and on the grid a shuffled matrix fails to embed while a 1D chain earns dimension 1 and not 2. On the torus d_W equals the minimal number of crossings of the L disjoint transverse loops. The crossing form J is not a metric — it fails indiscernibles and the triangle inequality, witnesses printed — while J mod 2 is the symplectic pairing, so the geometry-grade distance and the Γ-form are distinct exact structures sharing a crossing origin.

claims.headline: the boundary law at the corner tier: interface rank one degree below content
claims.prose: The stabiliser cut-rank of an s x s block on the toric carrier — the count of independent constraints genuinely straddling the cut, computed by the group-quotient route and by the restriction-rank route and gated equal inside the model — is IR2 = 2*PER - 10 = 8s - 10 with PER = 4s, while the distinguishable content capacity is capP = 2s^2 + 2s - 5. The interface aggregate sits exactly one degree below content, deg IR = deg C - 1, and the two are locked by a parameter-free form, 32*capP = (IR2+10)^2 + 8*(IR2+10) - 160. The model reproduces the sealed sequences IR2 = [6, 14, 22, 30, 38, 46, 54] and capP = [7, 19, 35, 55, 79, 107, 139] at L = 12, s = 2..8, and gates the two closed forms, the perimeter count and the parameter-free relation on that row; the sweep over every toric (L,s) to L = 12 (288 qubits, exact F2) is the sealed lane's and no gate re-runs it. The arithmetic is exact and gated, and the row that carries it stands at CANDIDATE and not at FORMAL: C-79 is an increment on the CANDIDATE emergence claim C-77, so this is a computed form and not an accepted theorem. The mechanism is exact bulk cancellation — the Euler density per interior cell is 1 + 1 - 2 = 0, so the source term is boundary-supported — and the positive control beside that zero is the scatter geometry, which has no interior and breaks the law in both tiers; that mechanism statement and that control are the sealed lane's too, and the URM computes neither.
claims.grounding: LANE_T42_D_DERIVE/t42d_derive.OUT.txt and LANE_T42_C_BOUNDCAP/t42_corner.OUT.txt (sealed) — the (L,s) sweep to L = 12, the Euler-density mechanism and the interior-free scatter control all live there; cut-rank / stabiliser region entropy borrowed from Hamma-Ionicioiu-Zanardi (2005) and Kitaev-Preskill (2006)

NOT FORMAL: C-79 is CANDIDATE and D-24 is DEFINED, so nothing here is an accepted theorem, and the earlier FORMAL label on this block was wrong. The subject is DEF-A stabiliser carriers, not any world record surface. What the URM computes and gates is the L = 12, s = 2..8 row and the four relations on it; the full (L,s) sweep, the Euler-density mechanism and the scatter control are sealed-lane content no check reproduces. What is one degree below content is the INTERFACE aggregate: stored record content is volume in both tiers, and the coefficient is venue-dependent (32 here, 216 in the world tier), with no universal coefficient established.

claims.headline: the boundary law at the world tier, counted grain by grain
claims.prose: The world tier is the n x n x n block of barrier records of the census access model — one record per grain, nearest-neighbour adjacency, access only through the block's own boundary. The model counts, grain by grain and never from a closed form, the independent access channels IFACE = 6n^2, the grains reachable without traversing another grain CAP_d1 = n^3 - (n-2)^3 = 6n^2 - 12n + 8, and the volume capacity CAP_total = n^3; the sealed sequences [24, 54, 96, 150, 216, 294, 384, 486, 600] and [8, 26, 56, 98, 152, 218, 296, 386, 488] at n = 2..10 reproduce exactly and are gated on that range. The same degree split holds — interface quadratic against content cubic, deg IR = deg C - 1 — with its own parameter-free form IFACE^3 = 216*CAP_total^2 at every n. CAP_d1 is the same integer as C-82's per-epoch min-cut, whose binding cut is the first grain layer — an identity C-82's own verifier records as carrying no separate weight, since under grain-disjoint independence the min-cut equals the entry-grain count by a two-line argument. What C-82 bounds is the certification RATE and not the total: cumulatively, re-use over epochs is not boundary-bounded, and on the sealed lane's computed range n = 2..12 the entire stored volume n^3 is certified at E_min <= 3 epochs — against C-82's own general bound, E_min >= ceil(n^3 / (6n^2 - 12n + 8)) ~ n/6, which grows without bound in n. The computed range is where E_min <= 3; it is not where the bound is flat. The min-cut schedule and the whole E_min table are the sealed lane's; the URM computes the three counts above and nothing else here.

claims.scope: SINGLE-CARRIER — C-79 is unaudited and C-82 is marked SINGLE-CARRIER (macrospin-CoCrPt); neither carries a two-carrier mark. The two rows sit at different tiers and the block does not average them: C-82 is FORMAL, C-79 is CANDIDATE, so the counts here are combinatorial facts about the model's own adjacency and the boundary-law reading of them rests on the CANDIDATE row. These are not measurements of a device. The URM computes and gates IFACE, CAP_d1 and CAP_total at n = 2..10; the schedule min-cut, the n = 11 and 12 rows and the E_min table are sealed-lane content no check reaches. The corner tier is pure Γ; the world tier runs through a coupling term, declared under C-77's openness clause. Stored content is volume here too: the boundary bounds the rate at which content can be certified, not how much of it there is, and the epoch count that clears the volume is bounded below by a quantity growing like n/6.

claims.headline: pure-Γ two-region structure is exactly zero beyond contact
claims.prose: Two disjoint s x s blocks on the toric carrier share no interface at any positive earned separation: I_IR = I_MI = 0 and no joint record content (JOINT_NEW = IDENT = JC = 0) at (L, s, g) = (8, 2, 2), (8, 3, 1) and (10, 4, 1), and on every case swept to L = 12 in the sealed lane. This is zero, not decay — and the venue's own limit belongs beside that sentence: on a stabiliser carrier every Pauli expectation is -1, 0 or +1, so no continuously decaying two-point profile exists here to be found at all, and a pure-Γ falloff on this venue could only have appeared as a decreasing integer sequence in an aggregate. What keeps the zero a measurement is that such a sequence was findable and the instrument produced ones like it: the positive controls sit in the same table — the same instrument, in the same validator run, returns the single-contact seam law I_IR = 2(s-2), I_MI = s-2, computed I_IR = 2, I_MI = 1 at s = 3 and I_IR = 4, I_MI = 2 at s = 4 — and, in the sealed lane, the double-contact law I_IR = 4(s-2)+1 with JOINT_NEW = 1 at L = 2s, and one inserted row of reach l making the same pair separation-dependent exactly at l = g+3. Contact is necessary and not sufficient: the s = 2 seam rank-absorbs to exactly zero.

claims.grounding: LANE_O54_A_CORNER/o54a_two_region.OUT.txt (sealed) — the L = 12 sweep, the double-contact law and the inserted-reach control (v) all live there; the venue's structural observation — every Pauli expectation on a stabiliser venue is -1, 0 or +1 — is LANE_O54_C_ATTEMPT/o54c_attempts.OUT.txt:285-291; stabiliser region entropy borrowed from Fattal-Cubitt-Yamamoto-Bravyi-Chuang (quant-ph/0406168) and Hamma-Ionicioiu-Zanardi (2005)

C-80 is marked TWO-CARRIER (toric-2x2; NAND floating gate); the two-region computations in this block are on the toric carrier. What the URM computes and gates is the three separated cases and the single-contact seam law at s = 3 and 4 — so the zero and one of its positive controls are both model-carried; the L = 12 sweep, the double-contact law and the inserted-reach control are sealed-lane content no check reaches. The zero is a statement about pure-Γ two-region structure only — any reach in the venue enters through a declared coupling term and is labeled INSERTED at its point of use. The venue forecloses a continuous profile in principle, so this zero is scoped to the corner tier by the lane's own structural observation and does not preclude other venues; it reads two ways, as the different-shape hypothesis or as no such structure being present, and neither reading is a baseline.

claims.headline: the winding pair's mutual interface is a distance-independent constant
claims.prose: Two non-contractible winding rings of width w on the toric carrier share exactly w at every separation: at L = 8, w = 2, with first rows 0 and 4, the model returns I_IR = I_MI = IDENT = 2 and capA = capB = capAB = 2, and in the sealed lane the same constant holds at every gap on every swept L. What is shared is pure identification of wrap classes, and the pairing creates nothing — JOINT_NEW = 0 on every row of the winding table, whose positive control is the double-contact block pair in the same sealed run's main sweep, where the identical instrument returns JOINT_NEW = 1. The one long-range relation pure Γ supplies between non-contractible regions is a constant that does not vary with how far apart they sit.

The URM computes and gates the single row at L = 8, w = 2; the constancy at every gap on every swept L, and the double-contact control, are sealed-lane content no check reaches. The constant is a topological invariant of the wrap classes and carries no reading as a long-range interaction; the rings are non-contractible, so the result says nothing about contractible regions. The D-15 control is a different configuration on the same instrument in the same sealed run, and it sits in that run's main sweep and not in the winding table.

claims.headline: the coupling-writer law w_min = d and the computed division of labor
claims.prose: Between two hole records — plaquettes removed from the toric carrier, the defect construction of Bravyi and Kitaev — the minimal admissible X-type writer that couples them has weight exactly the earned separation. The model scans the full admissible span exhaustively, 2^22 writers per pair, against a separation computed by breadth-first search on the generator-overlap graph from generator supports alone: on the (3,7) venue with u = (0,0), the pairs v = (0,1), (0,2), (0,3) return (d_gen, w_min, N_min) = (1,1,1), (2,2,1), (3,3,1) — slope 1, intercept 0, degeneracy 1. This is a growing law of confinement character (Wegner 1971, Wilson 1974), and the sealed lane's inserted-shortcut control — a third removed plaquette, a modified carrier — makes the same cost separation-independent at constant 1 across d_gen = 2, 3 and 5, so the instrument distinguishes flat from linear; that control is the lane's and the URM does not compute it. The division of labor follows and is computed: Γ supplies the boundary-degree law and the contact, topological and linear two-region character; the coupling supplies reach and any falloff; no falloff exponent has been earned by anything in Γ. That last statement is scoped by the lane's own structural observation and is not a general result: a stabiliser carrier admits only Pauli expectations -1, 0 and +1, so a continuously decaying pure-Γ profile could not have appeared on this venue in any case, and the O-54 verdict is a corner-tier verdict that does not preclude other venues.

The law is Γ-alone structure on a stabiliser carrier and carries no gravitational reading. The absence of an earned exponent is a corner-tier finding on a venue whose value set forecloses a continuous profile; what the venue did leave findable is a decreasing integer aggregate, and none appeared.

claims.headline: certifiable content is the stabiliser cut-rank, and outside writing is zero
claims.prose: The certify/write ledger asks what the outside world can learn of a region and what it can flip. Externally certifiable content — computed by the sector-rank route and by direct span intersection with a witness-constructed r_in, gated equal inside the model — equals the interface law identically: CERT = 8s - 10 = IR2 at s = 3, 4, 5 on L = 8, with the sealed 3x3 anchor STORED = 19, CERT = 14, HIDDEN = 5. Writers supported strictly outside the region flip nothing, WRITE0 = 0 on every region, and the positive control is in the same table: WRITE_B > 0 on every non-empty toric region, equal to CERT + 6 = 8s - 4 past the s >= 4 crossover. What a region withholds, HIDDEN = STORED - CERT, is volume, so the area-form aggregate counts what the outside can learn and not what the region holds. Further exact structures sit in the sealed lane and not in the URM, whose certifiability route takes an s x s square block alone: the comb geometry, which is all interface and reaches CERT = STORED = 80; three scatter seeds, which certify strictly more than the matched solid block; the g = 0 no-straddling controls, which return CERT = WRITE_B = 0 at volume STORED; and thickness protection — a band's record bit is certifiable at every width and writable through the interface layer only when thin, WRITE_GI_B = 1, 2, 1, 0 at widths 1, 2, 3 and >= 4 — so depth protects writability while leaving certifiability untouched.

claims.scope: SINGLE-CARRIER — C-81 is marked SINGLE-CARRIER (toric-2x2) and C-79 is unaudited and CANDIDATE, so the identity's boundary-law half rests on a row that is not an accepted theorem; C-81 itself is FORMAL. DEF-A, and scoped to solid regions with interiors: the comb geometry reaches CERT = STORED = 80 when the geometry is all interface, and the scatter control certifies strictly more than the matched solid block (CERT 86, 84, 86 against 46) without reaching its own STORED of 129, 128, 129 — the lane's gate there is CERT_scatter > CERT_block and not equality. The no-straddling controls return CERT = WRITE_B = 0 at volume STORED, so the instrument is sensitive in both directions. WRITE0 = 0 is a locality theorem about disjoint supports, not a durability claim. ProjectModel.certifiability takes an s x s square block only: what the model computes and gates is the CERT = IR2 identity at s = 3, 4, 5, WRITE0 = 0 on those three regions and the 3x3 anchor, while the comb, the scatter seeds, the no-straddling controls and the band-thickness profile are all sealed-lane content the URM does not compute and no check reaches.

claims.headline: the surface owns the clock: the certification window law
claims.prose: A record must be certified within its own lifetime, and clause (ii')'s durability tolerance supplies the window W = tau/t_epoch, with t_epoch the one declared model parameter, swept. The exact law is CERT_W(n) = min(n^3, W*(6n^2 - 12n + 8)), C-82's verified per-epoch min-cut carrying the boundary factor; the model reproduces the sealed table at n = 10, 100, 1000 — W = 1 gives [488, 58808, 5988008]; W = 1000 and W = infinity give [1000, 1000000, 1000000000]. W = 1 is exactly C-82's per-epoch law and W = infinity is exactly DEF-A's immortal-record corner, so the anytime reading is the t_m -> infinity idealisation the program already names. For any finite-lifetime surface certifiable content is boundary-bounded at scale, at degree D - 1. Beside the law the sealed lane tabulates three census surfaces at two declared epoch lengths each — 1e-9 and 1e-6 s for the CoCrPt grain, 1e-6 and 1e-3 s for the NAND cell, 1e-3 and 1 s for the DNA base — and on all six of those rows the modelled device size sits far below the crossover n* ~ 6W, so the full volume is certified within lifetime. t_epoch is declared rather than measured and n* is proportional to W = tau/t_epoch, so that is a conclusion about six declared rows and not a fact about any device; the lane's own summary generalises it to every terrestrial census device, which is wider than its own table, and the narrower form is what this block carries.

FORMAL: an exact law of the census-shaped access model given W, not a measurement. The URM computes and gates the CERT_W table and its W = 1 and W = infinity limits; the six-row crossover table is sealed-lane content no check reaches. t_epoch is a declared model parameter and W is derived from it and the surface's own tau, so the law fixes no epoch length for any real device — and the crossover statement in the prose is conditional on those declarations, six rows across three modelled surfaces, not a survey of devices.

claims.headline: a Γ-priced coupling reaches three classes, and no fourth appeared in the swept family
claims.prose: Price every admissible string by Γ's own cost w_min = d and sum: G_mu(d) = sum over admissible strings of mu^weight. Three classes are reached and each is located by computation — exponential decay below mu_c with leading term N_min*mu^d, the confinement cost with its exact degeneracy, gated equal to the true 2^22 Γ coset in weight and in count before any sum is taken; a single non-exponential non-divergent class at mu_c exactly; and divergence above mu_c, witnessed term by term. The critical point is the venue's own number, mu_c = 1/4 on the D = 2 corner and 1/2 on the D = 1 chain, each located three independent ways (Perron row-sum sandwich, exact sector sandwich, exact resolvent pole), and because mu_c = 1/deg the gated resolvent identity at criticality is the venue's discrete Poisson equation. The cross-dimension discriminator settles that the critical class belongs to the venue: mu = 1/4 is critical on D = 2 and subcritical on D = 1, and the two critical kernels occupy disjoint pre-declared windows. Exhaustiveness is the weakest of the three legs and is scoped as such: the lane's own wording is that within the swept family no further class appeared, and the T-44 judge's verdict is SATISFIED at family level in the computed dimensions — nothing here proves that a fourth class cannot exist.

claims.headline: the D = 3 critical member is computed as a power law whose exponent bracket contains 1
claims.prose: On the census access geometry's own degree-6 grain lattice — the earned D = 3 venue, row sums exactly 6 — the critical point is mu_c = 1/6 exactly, located three independent ways: a Perron row-sum sandwich, an exact sector sandwich 2*36^m/((2m+1)(m+1)(m+2)) <= N_2m(0) <= 36^m, and an exact-rational resolvent singular at 1/6 and solvable beside it.
